learningNotes.topic: Oracle Apps Report creation through RDF +RTF + XML publisher
learningNotes.content:
EBS XML Publisher Report — Notes 1. Create RDF Data Model Open Oracle Reports Builder. Create the SQL query, groups, columns, and parameters. Save the report as an RDF file. Example: XML_REPORT1.rdf Generate XML output from the RDF: File → Generate to File → XML This generated XML file is used as sample data for the RTF template. 2. Create RTF Template Open Microsoft Word with the BI Publisher / Template Builder add-in. Load the XML data file: BI Publisher → Load Data → Load XML Data Design the report using tables, headings, fields, totals, and formatting. For repeating records: BI Publisher → Insert → Table/Form Save the template as an RTF file. Example: XML_REPORT1.rtf 3. Place RDF File in Server Copy the RDF file to the custom application report directory: $XXPO_TOP/reports/US/XML_REPORT1.rdf 4. Create Concurrent Program Executable Navigation: System Administrator → Concurrent → Program → Executable Enter values similar to the screenshot: Note: Enter the RDF name without the .rdf extension. 5. Create Concurrent Program Navigation: System Administrator → Concurrent → Program → Define Enter: Field Example Value Program XML Report with Supplier Data Short Name XML_VENDOR_REPORT Application Purchasing Executable XML_VENDOR_REPORT Output Format XML Enabled Checked Use in SRS Checked The Output Format must be XML, as shown in the screenshot. This XML becomes the input for the BI Publisher RTF template. Add report parameters, if any, through the Parameters button. 6. Add Program to Request Group Navigation: System Administrator → Security → Responsibility → Request Add the concurrent program to the relevant Request Group. Assign the request group to the required responsibility. The user can now submit the concurrent request. 7. Create Data Definition Navigation: XML Publisher Administrator → Data Definitions → Create Data Definition Enter: Field Example Value Name XML_DEMO_XML1 Code XML_VENDOR_REPORT Application Purchasing Start Date Required effective date Important: Data Definition Code = Concurrent Program Short Name. Data Definition Code: XML_VENDOR_REPORT Concurrent Program Short Name: XML_VENDOR_REPORT 8. Create and Upload Template Navigation: XML Publisher Administrator → Templates → Create Template Enter: Field Example Value Name DEMY XML Template Code XML_VENDOR_REPORT Application Purchasing Type RTF Data Definition XML_DEMO_XML1 Default Output Type PDF File XML_REPORT1.rtf Language English Territory United States Click Apply to upload the RTF template. 9. Run the Report Submit the concurrent program from EBS. RDF Report ↓ Concurrent Program Output = XML ↓ XML Publisher Data Definition ↓ RTF Template ↓ Final Output = PDF / Excel / RTF The concurrent program produces XML data; XML Publisher applies the uploaded RTF template and generates the final PDF report.
